description: A trusted-device sign-in flow that pairs instructions with a simulated approval alert and code entry.
overview: At `md:` the section is a two-column grid; on smaller screens the columns stack. The left column shows an icon, a title and message for the current phase, and a status area: a `Spinner` while waiting, an `InputOTP` with one `InputOTPGroup` of six `InputOTPSlot` cells when a code is needed, or a Try again link after a denial. The right column shows a blurred backdrop image and a simulated device alert with Allow and Don't Allow actions, then the verification code, or a blocked message. A correct code shows a Sign-in approved confirmation.
usage: The phase (`ask`, `code`, `deny`, or `ok`), the code, and an error flag are held in `React.useState`. Copy for each phase lives in the `copy` object at the top of the file. The code is compared to `DEMO_CODE`, and the alert displays the same digits, so replace both with your verification API; in a real flow the alert belongs on the user's other device, and the browser side would poll or subscribe for approval instead of waiting for a click. Replace the `backdrop` image and the location text in the alert.
notes: The simulated alert has `role="alertdialog"` and `aria-label="Trusted device"`. The status area uses `aria-live="polite"`, and the `InputOTP` has `aria-label="Verification code"` and receives focus when it appears. The backdrop, its overlay, and the map illustration are `aria-hidden`. The backdrop loads from Unsplash; replace it with your own. Phase transitions are disabled with `motion-reduce:`.
